texts.en:
Excellent. Construction has been finished on our new Colony Building, and it should now begin producing resources.

£pops£ Pops will automatically be assigned to any £job£ Jobs created by £building£ Buildings as the population grows, but can also be encouraged to switch jobs.

To prioritize a Building;

£dot_green£ Select the £planet£ Planet in the Outliner
£dot_green£ Click the Economy tab
£dot_green£ Click on a Building
